text: Hello, I'm so sorry to message this late and I really hope I'm not wasting anyone's time, I know you must be busy with properly poorly children. I'm the aunt and I'm looking after my niece for a couple of nights while my sister is away for work, she's 5 months old. Tonight she felt hot so I took her temperature and its 39.1, I did it twice with the thermometer my sister left because I didnt beleive it the first time. The other thing is she hasnt done a poo for three days now, I've been counting the nappies and there's nothing, and she's been realy grumpy about it, going red in the face and pushing and getting cross. I don't know if the two things are connected or if I'm just panicking because she's not mine and I feel responsable. I've tried ringing my sister but her phone is off. Sorry again for the long message, I just didnt want to leave something out that matters. Thank you so much for reading.
